'''Graxitium''' was an element that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sakidopa]]. Graxitium was considered exotic and was used by the Sakiyans to make [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] circuitry. Using a secret process, the Sakiyans enriched graxitium at a [[Unidentified Sakiyan facility|location]] near the [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] known as [[the Godsheart]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Graxitium was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
